what: Verifier red-team: labeled attack/negative drafts run through the real FictionConsistencyVerifier to report per-check precision and recall (selectivity), complementing the campaign's coverage evidence (zero unverified serves). Offline, deterministic, no LLM calls.

method.labels: should_reject / should_pass; caught = rejected AND rejection names the targeted check
method.graph: fresh FictionGraph per case, seeded with the pinned novice identity (cycle-equivalent)

categories.D+: attacker-driven leakage pressure via the served-content echo channel
categories.SC: supported-claim violations (hedged/echoed/wrong answers on the declared surface; flag-gated)
categories.SC-: supported-claim false-positive probes (correct answers must pass)
